## `set_project_name`

*Available in [R](#set_project_name-r), [Python](#set_project_name-python)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to set the  project name. This will overwrite the
    current value if exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    set_project_name(project_name)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_name` - A string containing the analyst name

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A message stating the name has been changed.


=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    None
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    set_project_name(
        project_name,
        project=None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_name` (`str | None`) - None
    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - None

    <h4>Returns `None`</h4>

    *No return value*
